GainsBlock.rationale: `public override bool GainsBlock => true` (Colossus.cs:19) == the class attribute.

ctor.rationale: `base(1, CardType.Skill, CardRarity.Uncommon, TargetType.Self)` (Colossus.cs:27-30) == cost 1 / SKILL / UNCOMMON / SELF. No keywords.

CanonicalVars.maps_to: _block = 5 declared; the ColossusPower amount is inlined as 1 (colossus.py:30, 39)
CanonicalVars.issue: `new BlockVar(5m, ValueProp.Move)` maps to `_block = 5`, but the second var `new DynamicVar("Colossus", 1m)` (Colossus.cs:21-25) has no `_`-attribute in `_init_vars` -- the sim passes the literal 1 at the apply site. `base_block` is right, but `magic_number` returns None where the game prints a second var. Same mechanism and same verdict as card/bad_luck's CanonicalVars entry (rule 3): a printed DynamicVar with no corresponding `_`-attribute in `_init_vars`, so the sim's printed-number API reports the default and `full_env.card_features` (full_env.py:455-489) encodes the card wrongly for the policy. DORMANT for game fidelity (the dealt/applied number is identical), LIVE for the observation encoder. The BlockVar carries Move WITHOUT Unpowered -> POWERED block, so `BlockCmd.apply`'s `is_powered_attack` gate (cmds.py:145-147) lets the modifier dispatch run and this card is NOT in gap G1's blast radius; confirmed pool-wide by `py audit/tools/card_probes.py unpowered-block`, which lists only Entrench among ported cards.

OnPlay.rationale: Order matches: `CreatureCmd.GainBlock(Owner.Creature, DynamicVars.Block, cardPlay)` FIRST (Colossus.cs:35) == `BlockCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, self._block, card=self)`, then `PowerCmd.Apply<ColossusPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, DynamicVars["Colossus"].BaseValue, Owner.Creature, this)` (36) == `PowerCmd.apply(..., ColossusPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. Presentation, folded in: TriggerAnim (34) and the Vulnerable hover tip (17).

OnUpgrade.rationale: `DynamicVars.Block.UpgradeValueBy(3m)` (Colossus.cs:41) == `self._block += 3` (5 -> 8). The ColossusPower amount stays 1 when upgraded on both sides -- upgraded values checked.
